summary: The City Council announced a Small Business Support Program on September 5, 2023, backed by a unanimous vote and led by Councilwoman Angela Foster. It offers mentorship, micro-grants and low-interest loans, workshops, networking events, and digital empowerment training. Eleanor's Artisan Bakery, owned by Eleanor Kim, is highlighted as an early beneficiary, and local advisors praise the program's collaborative and digital focus.
one_line: The City Council launched a Small Business Support Program offering funding, mentorship, workshops and networking to help local small businesses grow and compete.
key_facts: The City Council announced the Small Business Support Program on September 5, 2023.
The program was backed by a unanimous City Council vote and spearheaded by Councilwoman Angela Foster.
Foster spoke at the launch event held at City Hall, saying "Small businesses are the backbone of our community."
The program includes mentorship programs where seasoned business leaders guide newcomers on marketing strategies and financial planning.
A dedicated fund offers micro-grants and low-interest loans tailored for small businesses.
Workshops and seminars cover topics from digital transformation to sustainable practices, plus e-commerce, digital marketing, and cybersecurity.
Networking events are meant to foster connections and collaborations among businesses.
Eleanor's Artisan Bakery, in the city's historical district, is one of the first to use the program; owner Eleanor Kim is considering a second location.
The note says Kim's bakery has been a local favourite since opening in April 2024, which is later than the September 2023 launch date of the program.
Jacob Mendoza, a local entrepreneur and business advisor, praised the program's collaborative potential, saying "we are stronger together."
Patricia Nguyen, Director of the Small Business Federation, was a chief consultant in the program's development.
The program is expected to enroll dozens of small businesses over the coming months and could serve as a model for other municipalities.
